title: Roswell crash and Stringfield's Marcel interview

tellings.quote: and he was one of the per first people to interview and publish his interview with Jesse Marcel Senior.

plain: In 1947 something was said to have crashed near Roswell, New Mexico, and a UFO researcher named Leonard Stringfield was among the very first to interview Jesse Marcel Senior, a military officer tied to that story, and to publish the interview. A researcher named Richard Dolan tells this while going over the history, without naming a source. If so, Stringfield helped bring a key Roswell witness to the public.
